overview_description.description:
Mamo is a Fintech startup headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We build payment and financial solutions for SMEs. Mamo is proud to own and operate all of its core and financial IP. Mamo is the first and only Fintech startup licensed by the DFSA with a Cat 3C Providing Money Services licence; allowing it to accelerate growth by offering a diverse suite of financial services.

Who uses Mamo products?
Mamo’s flagship product is Mamo Business and is used by hundreds of SMEs across the UAE. Our customers vary from large organizations, to professional services and health care and fitness operators. Our largest segments include B2B service providers, tourism and travel arrangements, events services, wellness and fitness services, retail office supplies and gifts and entertainment providers.

What is Mamo Business?
Mamo is a FinTech startup headquartered in Dubai, UAE. Mamo Business provides SMEs with an alternative to business banking: A platform designed like a consumer product that acts as a financial O.S. and a lifeline for SMEs. The platform includes three critical components to starting and growing a business: payments, spend management and analytics.

about_short_description.short_description: The Financial Operating System for businesses in MENA. Mamo regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority ("DFSA")

product.name: Mamo Corporate Card
product.description: A prepaid corporate card allowing businesses to issue unlimited virtual and physical cards, manage spending limits, and earn cashback on non-AED transactions.

product.name: Payment Collection Platform
product.description: A platform to collect payments via payment links, e-commerce checkouts, digital invoices, and QR codes, supporting multiple currencies and customizable options.

product.name: Expense Management Tool
product.description: A tool to capture, approve, and reconcile business expenses automatically, integrating with accounting software for streamlined financial operations.

product.name: Payouts Service
product.description: A service to automate and manage high-volume local payouts to suppliers, vendors, and contractors directly from the Mamo dashboard.

product.name: Recurring Payments Platform
product.description: A platform to automate subscription billing and manage recurring payments with flexible scheduling and real-time tracking.

product.name: Same-Day Settlements
product.description: A service providing businesses with access to their incoming payments on the same day to improve cash flow and operational flexibility.
